title: SQLite timestamp type converter for datetime parsing
description: flaskr/db.py registers a custom 'timestamp' converter via sqlite3.register_converter that parses stored TIMESTAMP values into Python datetime objects using datetime.fromisoformat. This enables template calls like post['created'].strftime('%Y-%m-%d') for date formatting.
spec:
1. Verify flaskr/db.py registers a 'timestamp' converter via sqlite3.register_converter('timestamp', lambda v: datetime.fromisoformat(v.decode())).
2. Verify get_db() opens the connection with detect_types=sqlite3.PARSE_DECLTYPES so the converter is applied.
3. Verify flaskr/schema.sql declares the post.created column as TIMESTAMP.
4. Verify flaskr/templates/blog/index.html calls post['created'].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'), which requires the converter to return a datetime object.
